Fleet usage ledger (#91): commit the tool, keep its output local (#124)

* fleet_ledger: commit the #91 fleet usage ledger as code; output stays local

The 2026-08-21 ledger lived only in gitignored misc/data/ and was lost to any
machine but the one that built it. This commits the tool (misc/fleet_ledger/,
stdlib only, not shipped in the dol distribution) and keeps everything it
produces out of the repo, in ~/.local/share/dol/fleet_ledger/<package>/,
because the output is derived from the fleet and some dependents are private.

- scan: per-dependent pins (40-char SHA, branch, upstream, ahead/behind,
  dirty/untracked, commit date) + AST census (imports through every binding
  form, star imports scored against the star'd module, subclassing closed over
  each repo's class graph, call-site kwargs with value kinds, decorators)
- baseline: every dependent's suite with the priv gate command, failing test
  ids from JUnit, timeouts recorded; diff refuses mismatched commands
- pin check/restore/undo: dry run by default, refuses dirty repos, never
  fetches or forces, writes its undo record before the first checkout
- zero-usage report with its three generated caveats; summary; history
- immutable records, schema_version, index.json, mark-superseded; a writer that
  refuses to persist local paths

Dependents and the gate command come from priv's dep_graph (reused, not
re-derived); repos= / --repo is the seam. misc/fleet_ledger joins testpaths.

Refs #91

* fleet_ledger: fix the adversarial review's findings

- Python 3.10: parse git's Z dates (CI blocker)
- baseline: redact local paths in suite output instead of losing the run;
  per-dependent errors recorded; whole process group killed on timeout;
  one outcome per test case
- diff: a run that did not complete is incomparable, never 'fixed'
- pin undo: skip a repo no longer detached at the restored pin; explicit-repos
  scans refuse fleet resolution; undo ids cannot collide
- census: position-aware bindings (later non-dol imports unbind), calls on
  attributes of dol symbols (Store.wrap), partial(wrap_kvs, ...), call bases,
  submodules shadowed by an export
- compat vs unknown judged against every defined name, via attribute access too
- writer: anchored prefix scrub, wider local-path patterns; ledger root and
  report output refused inside the repo; report pages warn they name dependents
- build/dist/env/venv skipped only at a repo's top; shallow-history caveat

Refs #91
